title: NHI Announces the Second Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI) announced today that it will pay its second quarter dividend of $0.92 per common share on August 7, 2026, to stockholders of record as of June 30, 2026. About National Health Investors, Inc. National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI), established in 1991 as a Maryland corporation, is a self-managed real estate investment trust ("REIT"). The Company owns, leases, operates and finances the development of high-quality real estate properties, focusing on senior housing communities and medical facilities. The Company operates through two reportable segments: Real Estate Investments and SHOP. The Company's investments in real estate properties include independent living facilities, assisted living facilities, entrance-fee communities, senior living campuses, skilled nursing facilities and hospitals.
